canVerify: Isolated normal boot; actual imported streamed music playback, sampled listener signal, keyboard movement and committed footstep cues, idle context work, same-biome music continuity, save/load replacement and native gamepad audio settings.
cannotVerify: Noncontiguous output windows prove a nonzero signal below full scale only in those sampled windows. They do not prove globally unclipped audio, subjective listening quality, physical speakers, all biome transitions, or Deck performance. Tests separately cover hidden-source refusals and crossfades. Three audio preferences are temporarily initialized and exactly restored; no gameplay state is injected.
